source.section: Table 1-1 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 Series Comparison; Section 1.1 Features

notes: This is a module datasheet, a separate document from the bare-die ESP32-S3 SoC datasheet cited in esp32-s3.json -- unlike the bare die, a specific module SKU has one fixed flash size, so total_flash_bytes is a real, non-null figure here: 8 MB Quad SPI flash, no PSRAM (the '-N8' suffix), per Table 1-1. total_sram_bytes (512 KB) is unchanged from esp32-s3.json since it's the same underlying die -- confirmed identically in this module datasheet's own 'CPU and On-Chip Memory' feature list ('512 KB SRAM'). The 16 KB RTC SRAM is excluded for the same reason as the bare-die profile: a distinct low-power retention domain, not general-purpose arena-eligible RAM. dev_kit_aliases is deliberately empty: the bare-die profile's existing note already establishes that ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 ships in multiple flash-size SKUs (8 MB via WROOM-1/-1U or 32 MB via WROOM-2) with no confirmed single mapping to this specific N8 SKU -- claiming that alias here without checking DevKitC-1's exact bill of materials would risk the same misrepresentation the bare-die profile's null flash figure was written to avoid.
